source.section: IT 1040 lines 1 to 8a (bundle PDF p.1); booklet PDF p.16 lines 1 to 4; PDF p.17 line 4 exemption table and line 8a; PDF p.18 bracket table; PDF p.5 rounding; MAGI PDF p.8; MAGI less exemptions worksheet PDF p.40

worked: Federal AGI = wages person 0 749,999.00 = 749,999.00. Federal taxable income = 749,999.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 734,249.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Ohio starts from federal AGI). IT 1040 line 1 federal AGI 749,999.00. Schedule of Adjustments additions: line 1 non-Ohio state or local interest 0.00; line 12 total 0.00; line 2a 0.00. Deductions: none; line 47 total 0.00; line 2b 0.00. Line 3 Ohio AGI = 749,999.00 + 0.00 - 0.00 = 749,999.00. Line 4: MAGI is line 3 with no business income deduction, 749,999.00, in the band 80,001 to 749,999: 1,900.00 each; 1 exemption x 1,900.00 = 1,900.00. Line 5 = 749,999.00 - 1,900.00 = 748,099.00. Line 6 taxable business income 0.00. Line 7 = 748,099.00. Line 8a tax: 748,099.00 is over 100,000: 2,394.32 plus 3.125% of (748,099.00 - 100,000.00 = 648,099.00) = 2,394.32 + 20,253.09375 = 22,647.41375; to the cent 22,647.41. Schedule of Credits line 1 = 22,647.41. MAGI less exemptions (worksheet PDF p.40) = 749,999.00 - 1,900.00 = 748,099.00 (equal to line 7 without business income), at or over 100,000.00, so the retirement income and senior citizen credits are not available. Line 2 retirement income credit: no covered retirement income, 0.00. Line 4 senior citizen credit: no one is 65 or older, 0.00. Line 10 credits = 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.00. Line 11 = 22,647.41 - 0.00 = 22,647.41. State income tax 22,647.41. The form works in whole dollars ('Round all figures to the nearest dollar', PDF p.5): line 8a would be 22,647; expected keeps the formula result. The row '$80,001 - $749,999' still allows 1,900.
